newsitem.title: USA: FULL TEXT - DuPont Reports Earnings Outlook.
newsitem.headline: FULL TEXT - DuPont Reports Earnings Outlook.

text.p: Dupont said its third quarter profit, excluding non-recurring items, would be at least 10 percent above analysts' estimates of $1.45 per share. Dupont shares rose 2-1/8 to 89 in early trading, following the announcement. A full text of the company's statement follows.

WILMINGTON, Del., Sept. 26 /PRNewswire/ -- DuPont (NYSE: DD) today announced that 1996 third quarter earnings per share excluding nonrecurring items are expected to be at least 10 percent above the current average of analysts' estimates of about $1.45 per share.

"Strong results in the company's upstream petroleum operations are the major factor in this improved outlook," said John A. Krol, President and CEO. Petroleum segment results are expected to exceed last year's third quarter by over 40 percent, mainly due to higher worldwide crude oil prices. A number of chemicals and specialties businesses also are expected to contribute to this improvement, most notably agricultural products.
The company also announced a third quarter nonrecurring charge of approximately $50 million after taxes for crop damage claims and legal expenses related to the recall of Benlate(R) 50 DF fungicide.
DuPont plans to release third quarter 1996 earnings on Wednesday, Oct. 23. SOURCE DuPont
